resources.string: Clear all data and sign out
This deletes cookies, site data and cache, and signs you out of your Google account in this app.
Try one switch at a time and compare. YouTube reloads when you change one.
H.264 video only\nLightest to decode. Max 1080p, a bit more data.
Identify as Chrome\nYouTube may serve faster code. Experimental.
Ad blocker (uBlock Origin)\nTurn off only to measure its cost. Ads will show.

Project Y is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by YouTube or Google. Videos and pages shown belong to YouTube and their creators.
